title: GPU Programming Domain LLM Fine-tuning and Inference Optimization
text: Built a data pipeline (PDF parsing, semantic chunking, QA generation, rule-based cleaning), applied LoRA SFT to Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct on NVIDIA A100 and added a RAG workflow over GPU technical documents, raising ROUGE-L from 0.2517 to 0.4126. Migrated the model to Moore Threads MTT S4000 with vLLM-MUSA and Triton, reaching ~13.0k tokens/s (+62.4% over the baseline).

title: Online Workload Resource Prediction for Data Centers
text: Led a university Spark Fund key project (completed and rated excellent). Online data-center workloads are latency-sensitive and strongly periodic, yet existing predictors under-use periodicity and are expensive to train. We identify the load period with the autocorrelation function, split the resource series into per-period subsequences and model the same-phase points across periods with LSTM. Across four real traces, it lowers MAPE on all four and cuts time cost by 1.6–4.0× relative to a standard LSTM. My part: period identification, sequence construction and splitting, and assisting LSTM modeling.
